custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011). A desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • [User-A]: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • One technician at this location: [Tech-A] (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Two customers used by this case only: a short name "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Badge Spot" and a long name "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Badge Spot Commercial Transport Services" (stands in for the case's example "Fibridge Commercial Transport Services"). "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Badge Spot" has two assets, one with no Unit.
  • Three work orders, all led by [Tech-A]: [WO-1] Approved for the long-named customer; [WO-2] an Estimate for "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Badge Spot"; [WO-3] Approved for "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Badge Spot" on the asset with no unit.
  • What must hold: the three cards differ in customer-name length, status and unit.

Setup

  1. Sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page (you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  2. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm each technician below is active at this location with Time Clock on, or add it: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] (e.g. Esther Howard).
  3. Top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Badge Spot Commercial Transport Services" > Save (if it already exists, open it instead). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, TRK-118) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Do the same for "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Badge Spot", and give "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Badge Spot" a second asset with Unit left empty.
  4. Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Badge Spot" and its asset > Save. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open: in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; the build offers only ready-made lines), then turn Line Approved on > Save & Close to make it Approved, or leave Line Approved off > Save & Close to keep it an Estimate. Repeat for three work orders in all: [WO-1] for "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Badge Spot Commercial Transport Services" (Approved, e.g. S1-702), [WO-2] for "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Badge Spot" (an Estimate, e.g. S1-455), [WO-3] for "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Badge Spot" with the no-unit asset (Approved, e.g. S1-472) (numbers on this site look like "S10043-17581").
  5. Set the leads: on an Approved work order pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Assign lead technician (an older screen shows Reassign lead technician) > click the technician (if the window still shows a Reassign button, click it).) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned. Here: [WO-1], [WO-2] and [WO-3] = [Tech-A].
  6. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search ZZAUTOTEST F2 Badge Spot — exactly [WO-1], [WO-2] and [WO-3] show, all led by [Tech-A]; [WO-2] is an Estimate and [WO-3] has no unit. If not, fix it before starting.
